name: Titanium.App.iOS.UserActivity
summary: The UserActivity module is used to enable device Handoff and to create User Activities.
description:
A UserActivity object requires the `activityType` property to be specified at creation time.
Additional properties can be set either at creation or set individually after creation.

Handoff will not work in the simulator.  You must build and run on a compatible device.

Handoff functionality depends on a few things:

  * You must be logged into the same iCloud account on each device you wish to use Handoff.
  * Handoff broadcasts activities via Bluetooth LE signals, so both the broadcasting and receiving devices must have Bluetooth LE 4.0 support.
  * Connect all devices to the same Wi-Fi network.

Make sure you have two devices that are logged onto the same iCloud account.

Since iOS 12, you can also configure the UserActivity API for handling Siri Shortcuts. See the
below API's and example or refer to the [Apple Siri Shortcuts Docs](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/sirikit/donating_shortcuts?language=objc)
for details.

examples.title: Creating a new User Activity
iOS 12+ Siri Shortcuts

properties.name: activityType
properties.summary: Name of the activity type.
properties.description:
Apple recommends using a reverse DNS scheme to name activities in the format: com.<company>.<application>.<activity_type>.

The activity type must also be registered in the `ios plist` section of the `tiapp.xml` file.  Add the `NSUserActivityTypes`
key and set its value to an array of activity type strings.

#### tiapp.xml
``` xml
<ti:app>
  <ios>
    <plist>
      <dict>
        <key>NSUserActivityTypes</key>
        <array>
          [string](api:Global.String)com.fooinc.musicalpedia.playtrack</string>
        </array>
      </dict>
    </plist>
  </ios>
</ti:app>
```

properties.name: eligibleForHandoff
properties.summary: Set to true if this user activity should be eligible to be handed off to another device

properties.name: eligibleForPrediction
properties.summary: A Boolean value that determines whether Siri can suggest the user activity as a shortcut to the user.
properties.description:
To donate a user activity to Siri Shortcuts, set eligibleForPrediction to `true` and make the 
user activity current. To make the user activity current, call the becomeCurrent method of activity.
For more information, see https://developer.apple.com/documentation/sirikit/donating_shortcuts?language=objc.

properties.name: eligibleForPublicIndexing
properties.summary: Set to `true` if the user activity can be publicly accessed by all iOS users.
properties.description:
Set to `true` if this user activity should be eligible for indexing for any user of the application,
on any device, or `false` if the activity contains private or sensitive information or which would not be useful to other
users if indexed.  You must also set either the `requiredUserActivityKeys` or `webpageURL` property.

properties.name: eligibleForSearch
properties.summary: Set to true if the user activity should be added to the on-device index.

properties.name: expirationDate
properties.summary: Absolute date after which the activity is no longer eligible to be indexed or handed off.
properties.description:
The date will be a string in the following format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'+0000'"
For example, `2015-12-25T23:30:55.978+0000`

properties.name: keywords
properties.summary: An array of string keywords representing words or phrases that might help the user to find the activity in the application history.

properties.name: needsSave
properties.summary: Set to true every time you have updated the user activity and need the changes to be saved before handing it off to another device.

properties.name: persistentIdentifier
properties.summary: A value used to identify the user activity.
properties.description:
Set this property to a unique value that identifies the user activity so you can later delete it with 
Ti.App.iOS.UserActivity.deleteSavedUserActivitiesForPersistentIdentifiers method.

properties.name: requiredUserInfoKeys
properties.summary: An array of String keys from the userInfo property which represent the minimal information about the user activity that should be stored for later restoration.

properties.name: supported
properties.summary: Determines if user activities are supported (`true`) or not (`false`) by the device.

properties.name: title
properties.summary: An optional, user-visible title for this activity such as a document name or web page title.

properties.name: userInfo
properties.summary: The userInfo dictionary contains application-specific state needed to continue an activity on another device.

properties.name: webpageURL
properties.summary:
When no suitable application is installed on a resuming device and the `webpageURL` property is set,
the user activity will instead be continued in a web browser by loading the specified URL.
properties.description: Only supports the `http://` and `https://` protocols.  Any other protocol will throw an error.

methods.name: addContentAttributeSet
methods.summary: Adds a Titanium.App.iOS.SearchableItemAttributeSet to the user activity.

parameters.name: contentAttributeSet
parameters.summary: SearchableItemAttributeSet object that contains the set of properties you want to display for a searchable activity.

methods.name: becomeCurrent
methods.summary: Marks the activity as currently in use by the user.
methods.description:
For example, you should mark the activity associated with the active window as current.
A newly created activity is eligible for continuation on another device after the first time it becomes current.

methods.name: deleteAllSavedUserActivities
methods.summary: Deletes all user activities created by your app.
methods.description:
The [Titanium.App.iOS.UserActivity.useractivitydeleted](api:Titanium.App.iOS.UserActivity#useractivitydeleted) event is fired after deleting the 
user activities. Listen and wait for this event to fired to ensure that the system deletes 
the activities (or marks them for deletion).

methods.name: deleteSavedUserActivitiesForPersistentIdentifiers
methods.summary: Deletes user activities created by your app that have the specified persistent identifiers.
methods.description:
The [Titanium.App.iOS.UserActivity.useractivitydeleted](api:Titanium.App.iOS.UserActivity#useractivitydeleted) event is fired after deleting the 
user activities. Listen and wait for this event to fired to ensure that the system deletes 
the activities (or marks them for deletion).

parameters.name: persistentIdentifiers
parameters.summary: Array of persistent identifiers of user activity.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.summary: Invalidates an activity when it is no longer eligible for continuation.
methods.description:
For example, when the window associated with an activity is closed, you should invalidate the activity.
An invalid activity cannot become current.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.summary: Determines if user activities are supported (`true`) or not (`false`) by the device.

returns.summary: Returns `true` if the device supports user activity.

methods.name: resignCurrent
methods.summary: Marks the activity as currently **not** in use and ineligible to be continued.

events.name: useractivitydeleted
events.summary:
Fired when the user activity get deleted using the [Titanium.App.iOS.UserActivity.deleteAllSavedUserActivities](api:Titanium.App.iOS.UserActivity#deleteAllSavedUserActivities) or 
[Titanium.App.iOS.UserActivity.deleteSavedUserActivitiesForPersistentIdentifiers](api:Titanium.App.iOS.UserActivity#deleteSavedUserActivitiesForPersistentIdentifiers) methods.

events.name: useractivitywascontinued
events.summary: Fired when the user activity was continued on another device.

properties.name: activityType
properties.summary: The activityType of the User Activity triggering the event.

properties.name: title
properties.summary: The title of the User Activity if defined.

properties.name: webpageURL
properties.summary: The webpageURL of the User Activity if defined.

properties.name: userInfo
properties.summary: Dictionary object containing the userInfo data of the User Activity.

events.name: useractivitywillsave
events.summary:
Fired if the activity context needs to be saved before being continued on another device.

To fire the event, set the UserActivity object's `needsSave ` property to `true`.

The receiver should update the activity with current activity state.

After the event is fired, iOS will reset the `needsSave` property to false.

deprecated.notes: Set the property `needsSave` to true every time you update current activity state instead.
